title: Return History Addition on the Credit Builder Accounts Made-Good Relief
content:
The relief share of the made-good relief on a Credit Builder account grows when the account has few other returned payments. The returned payment the relief concerns is the account's most recent returned payment; the others are the account's remaining returned-payment entries, whatever their code, by their dates.

## Clause

When no other payment on the account was returned in the 12 whole calendar months before today (a line dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 12 months earlier falls outside them), the first-return addition is added to the share; when exactly one other was, the second-return addition; when two or more were, nothing is added for return history.

| Other payments returned in the 12 months | Added to the relief share |
|---|---|
| none | first-return addition: 0.2 (20 percentage points) |
| exactly one | second-return addition: 0.1 (10 percentage points) |
| two or more | 0.0, nothing added |

## Counting the 12 months (hypothetical dates)

Today 5 September: another return dated 5 September of the previous year falls outside; one dated 6 September of the previous year is counted.
